answer: Because the meadow liability is entered in the sonnet ledger at admission, the whisper audit shows the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A sponsor carries 57% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. A farm must hence place its own capital behind every alias it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. That is 15 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
